title: Evidence grows as likelihood wealth
hook: Two stated cases: explore the fixed-alternative likelihood ratio under a Bernoulli null.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the fixed-alternative likelihood ratio under a Bernoulli null affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Wealth, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the fixed-alternative likelihood ratio under a Bernoulli null in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
